meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: 装上后,遇到 Git 任务时它会先查看仓库现状,再只执行你明确要求的操作,如分组提交、重写历史或查证改动来源;不会擅自推送、重置或删除,也不会动无关的未提交改动。
howto.when: 当你要求提交代码改动、重写 Git 历史,或回答某次改动在何时、由谁、为何发生等历史问题时触发;普通代码编辑不会调用。

say.text: 请检查工作区改动,按逻辑整理成几个提交,别动其他文件。
say.note: 先看状态和差异,再逐个提交。

say.text: 把最近三次提交压成一个,重写提交信息。
say.note: 会用交互式变基重写,并检查新历史。

say.text: 查一下是哪个提交改了这个文件里这段代码。
say.note: 会定位到提交并提供证据。

howto.what_en: Claude handles Git work: checks repo first, then only does what you ask—grouped commits, safe rewrites, tracing. It never pushes, force-pushes, resets, stash-pops, or deletes on its own, and leaves dirty unrelated changes alone.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to commit changes, rewrite branch history (e.g., rebase/squash), or answer Git-history questions (who/when/why something changed). Not for ordinary code edits.

say_en.text: Split the working-tree changes into logical commits; don't touch unrelated files.
say_en.note: It checks status and diffs, then commits each atomic group.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one and rewrite the message.
say_en.note: Uses interactive rebase and verifies the result.

say_en.text: Find which commit changed this file's line.
say_en.note: Traces the change and gives commit evidence.
